question: With K target support labels (K=5,20), does adapting only the decoder on a frozen OlmoEarth cache (A1) beat retraining a raw model (A4) on the same K tiles? This is the target-few-shot axis of 'Reuse or Retrain?'. MS-94 established A1 > A0 by +0.068..+0.080; the missing comparator is raw.
manifests: identical to CacheTune PT-0 (artifacts/cachetune_pt0/*_manifest.json): same support draws, same query, same seeds — A1 numbers are recomputed in-run for comparability

arms.A1: source P4 decoder, all decoder params adapted on support; BN statistics frozen; Adam lr 1e-4 wd 1e-4
arms.A4s: OfficialUNet3D(in_channels=11: 10 bands + month channel, pilot input contract) trained FROM SCRATCH on the K support tiles only; BN in train mode (no source statistics exist); Adam lr 1e-3 wd 1e-4
arms.A4w: OfficialUNet3D initialised from the source-trained P2 checkpoint of the same development fold and seed (trained now with the sealed pilot snapshot, arm P2), then adapted on support with BN frozen; Adam lr 1e-4 wd 1e-4. This is the fair 'retrain' comparator: same source supervision as A1, raw pixels instead of cache.
arms.A4w_p3_sensitivity: OfficialUTAE source-initialised from a P3 source checkpoint — sensitivity only, run after the P2 primary if GPU allows

fixed_before_results.seeds: support draw seed s paired with source checkpoint seed s, s in {1,2,3}
fixed_before_results.primary_metric: positive-tile macro IoU at the FP-matched operating point (budget = A0 empty-tile FP at 0.5 on query, applied equally)
secondary: raw bytes read (A4 reads raw_u16; A1 reads none)
fixed_before_results.exposure_sensitivity: fixed-exposure variant: updates = 300 * K/5 (K=5 → 300, K=20 → 1200) so every support tile is exposed ~480 times in both K; reported for A1 and A4w. If the K-ordering conclusion differs between fixed-update and fixed-exposure, the result is demoted to 'optimization-sensitive'.

verdict_rules.reuse_wins: A1 - A4w >= +0.01 in both development regions at a given K (same direction) -> 'cache reuse + head adaptation beats raw retraining at that label budget'
verdict_rules.retrain_wins: A4w - A1 >= +0.01 in both regions -> record honestly; the reuse story narrows to K=0
verdict_rules.scratch_reference: A4s is reported but never used as the headline comparator (a from-scratch model at K=5 is expected to fail; that is a floor, not a finding)

limitations_declared: development regions only (china, chimanimani) — a screen, not the confirmatory matrix
300 fixed updates may favour one arm; this is why A4w (source-initialised) is the headline comparator and A4s only a floor
K=20 < K=5 anomaly observed for A1 in MS-94 is not analysed post hoc here

confirmatory_protocol_registered_now.trigger: development gate passes (A1 - A4w >= +0.01 at K=5 in both china and chimanimani, same direction)
confirmatory_protocol_registered_now.regions: the 8 confirmatory Sen12 regions (hiroshima, hokkaido, indonesia, itogon, kyrgyzstan1, kyrgyzstan2, newzealand, thrissur)
confirmatory_protocol_registered_now.source_checkpoints: existing confirmatory P4_seed{1,2,3} and P2_seed{1,2,3} in /home/work/data/olmoearth/confirmatory/holdout_<region>/ (no retraining)
confirmatory_protocol_registered_now.manifests: same PT-0 rule per region: ann_id grouping, 10 km blocks, 3 km buffer, >=40% positive support, K in {5,20}, 3 draws, sealed before any metric is read
confirmatory_protocol_registered_now.metric: FP-matched positive-tile macro IoU, region as statistical unit

verdict.reuse_wins: A1 > A4w by >= +0.01 in >= 6/8 regions at K=5
verdict.crossover: A1 wins at K=5 in >= 6/8 and A4w wins or ties at K=20 in >= 5/8
verdict.retrain_wins: A4w > A1 by >= +0.01 in >= 6/8 at both K
verdict.indonesia_rule: report the falsifier region separately regardless of the aggregate

claim_corrections_adopted_2026_09_02: M65 headline = 6/8 preregistered wins (5/8 strong); '7/8 vs best raw' is a region-mean observation, not the headline

raw-baseline objection is 'substantially weakened' (two raw temporal architectures both lose), not 'closed' — P3 is a matched reimplementation, not the leaderboard recipe; 40-epoch BCE vs 75-epoch BCE+Dice audit pending
Presto: 'the effect did not extend to a matched Presto control, and native grid did not change the ranking' — not generic GeoFM superiority
Nepal: 'embedding-based prioritisation consistent with external flood proxies' — not 'superior to classical change detection' (post-event NDWI AUPRC .291 > OLMo .255; spatial-block CI includes 0)
MS-94 A1 gain is a strong development signal on two exposed regions, not a paper result
